summary.en: US futures retreated on Juneteenth ahead of the US-Iran nuclear agreement milestone, while economic data (ADP +122K jobs, ISM Services PMI at 54.5) reinforces Fed's higher-for-longer stance amid surging oil prices ($96 WTI, $97 Brent). Chip stocks rallied on improved geopolitical sentiment and TSMC/Nvidia strength.
summary.zh: 美盘前受 Juneteenth 假期和 US-伊朗核协议里程碑影响，美股期货回落。强劲的经济数据（ADP+12.2K 职位、ISM 服务业 PMI54.5）与飙升的油价支撑美联储维持高利率立场。芯片股在地缘政治缓和及 TSMC/Nvidia 走强带动下上涨。

title.en: US Futures Retreat as Juneteenth Holiday and US-Iran Deal Loom
title.zh: 美盘前期货受 Juneteenth 假期和 US-伊朗协议预期影响回落

impact.en: E-mini S&P futures down 0.5%, Nasdaq -0.7% overnight due to holiday and geopolitical easing from the upcoming permanent peace deal milestone
impact.zh: 美股指期货因假期和即将达成的永久和平协议的地缘政治缓和，标普期货跌 0.5%，纳指跌 0.7%

macroRisk.en: Yes - Holiday effect combined with Iran peace deal progress could lead to further downside or stabilization ahead of Monday open.
macroRisk.zh: 是——假期效应加伊朗和平协议进展可能在周一开盘前导致进一步下跌或企稳

title.en: Strong Economic Prints: ADP Jobs +122K, ISM Services PMI Hits 54.5
title.zh: 强劲经济数据：ADP 职位+12.2K，ISM 服务业 PMI升至 54.5

impact.en: Robust private sector employment and services expansion signal resilient economy, reducing near-term rate cut probability to below 20% for September FOMC
impact.zh: 强劲的非联储就业和服务业扩张显示经济韧性，降低近期内利率下调概率

macroRisk.en: Yes - hawkish Fed pivot increases bond volatility, supports yield-capped equities over duration-sensitive names
macroRisk.zh: 是——鹰派美联储转向增加债券波动性，支持收益率封顶股票而非久期敏感型股票

title.en: Oil Prices Surge on Middle East Supply Tightness and Drawdowns
title.zh: 油价因中东供应紧张和库存降幅飙升

impact.en: WTI at $96 (+2.4%), Brent $97.81 (+1.89%). EIA inventory draw of 7.97M barrels exceeds expectations, geopolitical tensions drive US crude exports
impact.zh: WTI$96(+2.4%)、Brent$97.81(+1.89%)。EIA 库存降幅超预期，地缘紧张推动美国原油出口

bearish: growth costs for consumers and businesses

macroRisk.en: Yes - rising oil feeds inflation expectations, complicates Fed's dual mandate, could push December rate hike probability to 41%
macroRisk.zh: 是——油价上涨助推通胀预期，令美联储双重使命复杂化

title.en: Semiconductor Rally Led by TSMC (+9%) and Nvidia on AI Demand
title.zh: 半导体板块飙升：TSMC(+9%) 和 Nvidia 因 AI 需求领涨

impact.en: PHLX Semiconductor Index +7.3%. Taiwan central bank raises growth forecast to 9.45% citing chip demand boom; TSMC supply constraints create bottleneck premium
impact.zh: 费城半导体指数+7.3%。台湾央行上调增长预期至 9.45%，AI芯片需求激增；TSMC供应限制形成瓶颈溢价

macroRisk.en: No - sector-specific AI demand drives rally; supply chain exposure to Taiwan's economic cycle supports outperformance despite macro headwinds.
macroRisk.zh: 否——板块特定的AI需求驱动上涨；台湾经济周期的供应链暴露支撑优于大盘的表现。

title.en: Treasury Yields Dip 3bps to 4.45% as Oil Calm and Geopolitical Easing Ease Inflation Fears
title.zh: 美债收益率回落至 4.45%，油价缓和加地缘政治缓解降低通胀担忧

impact.en: 10Y yield below 50-day MA at ~4.40%. Short-term yields remain elevated due to FOMC hawkish dot plot shift; curve inversion deepens
impact.zh: 10年期收益率低于 50日均值约 4.4%；短期收益率因鹰派点阵图而保持高位；曲线倒挂加深

macroRisk.en: Yes - curve inversion signals recession risk; yield stability supports rate-sensitive sectors but broader economy faces slowdown pressures.
macroRisk.zh: 是——曲线倒挂预示衰退风险；收益率稳定支持利率敏感型板块，但整体经济面临放缓压力。

title.en: DXY Breaks Above 100.55 as Fed's Hawkishness Supports Dollar
title.zh: 美元指数突破 100.55，美联储鹰派立场支撑美元

impact.en: Dollar strengthens against euro and pound; EM assets face headwinds but multinationals benefit from FX tailwind amid resilient US data
impact.zh: 美元对欧元和英镑走强；新兴市场资产承压，但跨国企业受益于汇率顺风

macroRisk.en: Partial - strong dollar pressures EM debt servicing but supports yield-capped US equities; mixed signal for overall market breadth.
macroRisk.zh: 部分——强美元增加新兴市场债务负担但支持收益率封顶美股；对整体市场广度信号混合。

title.en: Gold and Silver Prices Hold Despite West Asia Tensions Easing
title.zh: 黄金和白银价格在地缘紧张缓和时保持坚挺

impact.en: Precious metals gain 3% on safe-haven flows from persistent inflation concerns, oil price link creates complex dynamics in gold market.
impact.zh: 贵金属因持续通胀担忧的安全港流入上涨 3%，油价与黄金的关联在市场产生复杂动态。

bearish: real yields stabilization reducing safe-haven appeal

macroRisk.en: No - gold prices reflect inflation expectations and central bank demand; oil-price correlation creates mixed signals for precious metals sector.
macroRisk.zh: 否——金价反映通胀预期和央行需求；油价相关关系为贵金属板块提供混合信号。

ai.en: AI demand remains robust; chip design firms and cloud capex support sector. Nvidia announces $25B asset sale for data center expansion.
ai.zh: AI需求保持强劲；芯片设计公司和云计算资本开支支撑板块。Nvidia宣布出售 250 亿美元资产以扩大数据中心业务。

semiconductor.en: Rally led by TSMC (+9%) and broad semiconductor index +7.3%. Taiwan's growth outlook to 9.45% validates AI cycle. AMD up significantly following Nvidia.
semiconductor.zh: 板块领涨于TSMC(+9%)和费城半导体指数+7.3%，台湾增长预期至 9.45%验证AI周期。AMD跟随Nvidia大幅上涨。

bigTech.en: Mega-caps benefit from AI capex but remain cautious amid rate uncertainty. Cloud services drive earnings growth for most hyperscalers.
bigTech.zh: 巨头受益于 AI 资本开支，但利率不确定性下保持谨慎；云业务驱动大多数超大规模云计算厂商的盈利增长。

energy.en: Oil prices at $96 WTI /$97 Brent on supply tightness and Middle East tensions. EIA drawdown of 7.97M barrels signals strong demand, supporting sector.
energy.zh: WTI油价约$96，Brent约$98，供应紧张和中东紧张局势支撑。EIA库存降幅 797 万桶显示需求强劲。

ev.en: Sector faces headwinds from higher energy costs and inflation. EV demand softens as consumer purchasing power erodes in expensive environment.
ev.zh: 板块受高能源成本和通胀打压；EV需求疲软，消费者购买力在昂贵环境下被侵蚀。

market.en: Mixed sentiment ahead of Juneteenth holiday. S&P +1.1%, Nasdaq +2.5% close Friday, but Asia futures retreated 0.5-0.7%. Rate volatility remains key driver.
market.zh: Juneteenth 假期前市场情绪混合。标普周五收于+1.1%，纳指+2.5%，但亚洲期货回落 0.5-0.7%。利率波动是主要驱动因素。

preciousMetals.en: Gold and silver gain on safe-haven flows amid inflation concerns, despite easing geopolitical risks in West Asia. Precious metals hold defensive appeal.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金和白银在通胀担忧下获得安全港流入，尽管西亚洲地缘风险缓和。贵金属保持防御吸引力。

oil.en: WTI at $96.02 (+2.4%), Brent $97.81 (+1.89%). Supply constraints from Middle East tensions support prices. EIA drawdown of 7.97M barrels exceeds forecasts.
oil.zh: WTI$96(+2.4%)，Brent约$98。中东紧张局势支撑供应限制下的价格。EIA库存降幅超过预期。

futures.en: S&P E-mini -0.5%, Nasdaq E-mini -0.7% in overnight Asia session; Juneteenth holiday and Iran peace deal milestone weighing on sentiment ahead of Monday.
futures.zh: 亚洲盘美股指期货回落；Juneteenth 假期加伊朗和平协议里程碑影响市场情绪。

treasury10Y.en: 10-year Treasury yield around 4.45% (-3bps), below its ~4.40% level; inflation easing but curve inversion signals recession risk remains.
treasury10Y.zh: 美债收益率约 4.4%，略低于其水平；通胀缓和但曲线倒挂显示衰退风险。

dxy.en: Dollar Index above 100.55 resistance, euro and pound extend losses; Fed's hawkish stance supports greenback amid strong US data.
dxy.zh: 美元指数在 100.55 支撑之上，欧元英镑扩大损失；强美元数据。

oil.en: WTI at $96, Brent near$98; Middle East supply constraints and EIA draw support prices. Oil-price inflation transmission concerns remain.
oil.zh: 油价维持高位，供应限制和库存降幅支撑价格。通胀传导担忧仍然存在。

keyRisk.en: June 20: US-Iran peace deal progress, Juneteenth holiday closing; June 19-26 countdown to permanent agreement. Fed's December rate hike probability elevated.
keyRisk.zh: 主要风险：US-伊朗和平协议进展，假期前一日；永久协议倒计时。美联储利率上调概率较高。

note.en: Mixed sentiment due to holiday + geopolitical easing vs economic strength. Sector divergence (semis/rally, energy/strong oil, EV/headwinds) reflects macro uncertainty on inflation and rates.
note.zh: 混合情绪受假期、地缘缓和与经济强度影响。板块分化反映通胀和利率的不确定性，半导体大涨而能源走强但电动车承压。
